analysis:
Examined all supplied BASE excerpts and the bounded patch for provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Inference/Distributed/Console/ClusterSetupWizardLiveOperations.swift. The visible additions introduce optional servingScope (HEAD 45–47) and a coordinator planning parameter defaulting to false (HEAD 523–526). BASE planning reads configured MTP mode, probes capabilities and tensor-assistant quotes (555–636), then derives placement (644–650); adoption rechecks capability and installs/delivers the saved plan (685–749). Pairing, pinned SSH/link routing, owner-only setup files, worker hashing, local authenticated prompt probes and blocking/report behavior were also examined as surrounding context, not reported as new issues.
No concrete regression is established by the visible changes. The patch is truncated before the new scope-dependent planning logic, and only BASE source is supplied for the remaining changed calls (BASE 610/617; HEAD 618/625). Integration must inspect HEAD 563–565 and 618/625, OnboardingLive.planningScope, serving-scope persistence and callers of plan(coordinator:), to determine whether public/local planning preserves capability admission, resource bounds and authorization requirements (A-016, TB-011, T-052/T-053). T-041 requires checking whether coordinator scope changes only placement quoting or also cache eligibility/bindings; this excerpt does not show cache construction or a cache-control change. Missing HEAD behavior prevents a security conclusion on that scope propagation; unchanged external implementations are not evidence of a regression.
